reason: I still think my business is won by handshakes, not systems, but the free list of 15 companies costs me one call, and a pilot with nothing up front, a EUR 900 cap I can sign myself and trade-fair meetings booked at my stand is cheap enough to test. I would take relationship mode only, and if the 15 companies are names I already know or the wrong fit, I stop there.
objection: Someone I don't know writing to my buyers under my name. One bad message to the wrong purchasing manager costs me more than EUR 900, and one logistics client with 45 meetings is not proof for a manufacturer like us.
